definitions.session: A trading session is a date on which at least 3,000 common stocks or ADRs (security type CS or ADRC) have a daily bar. Dates come from the data, never the clock, so a weekend run still reads the last real session and a partial ingest is skipped.
definitions.as_of: The newest session. Every number in this file is as of its close.
definitions.universe: Common stocks and ADRs (CS, ADRC) that closed at 1.00 dollar or more on the as_of session.
definitions.new_highs_lows: A new high: the as_of high is at or above the highest high of the 252 sessions before as_of (as_of itself excluded). A new low: the as_of low is at or below the lowest low of those 252 sessions. Only universe stocks with a usable bar (high and low above zero) on at least 245 of those 252 sessions, and on as_of, are eligible (eligible_n). A missing or zero high or low never counts.
definitions.advances_declines: A universe stock advances if its as_of close is above its close on the previous session, declines if below, unchanged if equal. A stock with no bar on the previous session is counted in no_prior, not in the three.
definitions.stage: Weinstein stage on the 30-week line: the average close of the 150 sessions ending as_of. Its slope compares it with the same average ending 20 sessions earlier: rising if more than 1% higher, falling if more than 1% lower, flat otherwise. Rising: stage 2 if the as_of close is at or above the line, else stage 3. Falling: stage 4 if the close is at or below the line, else stage 1. Flat: stage 3 if the line is above where it stood 60 sessions earlier (it came from an advance), else stage 1. A stock missing more than 7 of the 210 sessions ending as_of (or listed for fewer) is unstaged. Stages 1-4 plus unstaged add up to the universe.
definitions.themes: The active themes: each name's newest theme row dated no earlier than 7 days before as_of (a row dated after as_of counts), dropped if that newest row is Retired.
definitions.ecosystems: The active themes grouped by ecosystem (the curated group each theme is filed under; a theme with no group is filed under Other). A group counts each stock once, however many of its themes hold it. Its return is the equal-weighted average of those unique stocks' returns, measured exactly as a theme's is (see theme_returns); n_ counts the stocks that had both closes and up_ counts those with a positive return. A stock held by themes in two groups counts once in each.
definitions.theme_returns: Equal-weighted average of member returns in percent, from the close 1, 5 or 21 sessions before as_of (Today, 1W, 1M) to the as_of close; YTD is from the last close on or before the prior calendar year's last session. A member without both closes drops out of that window; n_ counts the members that had them; a window no member could fill is null.
definitions.theme_membership: Membership is TODAY's list, applied to every window. Over 1M and YTD this flatters a theme: names often joined it because they had already run.
definitions.stocks: One entry per universe stock and per active-theme member: [stage 1-4 or null, RS rank or null, indexes into themes]. The RS rank is from the newest full nightly RS run (score_date) and ranks only the roughly 2,400 names that run keeps.
definitions.not_claimed: Display only. Nothing here feeds a trade, a grade, an alert or any sizing.
